question: Features of Fundamental Rights in the Indian Constitution partly derives its inspiration from the Bill of Rights, enshrined in the Constitution of _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**U.S.A.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Features of Fundamental Rights in the Indian Constitution partly derives their inspiration from the Bill of Rights, enshrined in the **Constitution of the United States of America.**
 
• It is enshrined in** Part III of the Constitution from Articles 12 to 35.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• Fundamental rights are the guaranteed rights includes **6 rights **which are as follows :

 
 
• **Right to Equality**
 
• **Right to freedom**
 
• **Right against exploitation**
 
• **Right to freedom of Religion**
 
• **Cultural and Educational Rights**
 
• **Right to constitutional Remedies**
